grok-2-1.summary: withSystemErrorPath defects on reachable typed errors whose causes are not ErrnoException.
grok-2-1.fix: Restore conditional non-errno cause passthrough, retaining S.is(ErrnoException) and ErrnoException.from for errno causes. Add a typed InvalidData/no-defect regression for writeFile("/missing/.", bytes) in internal/volume.coverage.test.ts; cover deterministic non-errno allocation failure without a huge allocation if a local seam permits it.

sol-2-1.summary: An unforced S3 rewrite removed the upstream assertion that an unscoped temporary directory survives an inner scope closing.
sol-2-1.fix: Restore the upstream inner Effect.scoped around makeTempDirectory, the first stat assertion and the returned path; leave the second stat assertion outside the scope. Preserve imports and independent law-forced assertion migrations.

sol-2-2.summary: The named isOpenFlag runtime constraint is a handwritten literal predicate without an executable schema.
sol-2-2.fix: Define an identity-annotated internal OpenFlag LiteralKit with exactly r, r+, w, wx, w+, wx+, a, ax, a+ and ax+; derive isOpenFlag with S.is(OpenFlag). Preserve accepted flags and BadArgument behavior; extend internal/volume.coverage.test.ts open-flag regressions using the sanctioned deliberatelyInvalid helper for invalid input.

fable-2-1.summary: Full inode schema guards introduce linear validation of unrelated directory entries into constant-time inode-kind checks.
fable-2-1.fix: Replace kind-only S.is(DirectoryInode)/S.is(FileInode) uses at lines 403, 515, 696, 1057, 1634, 1643 and 2947 with existing InodeEntry.isAnyOf discriminant guards. Preserve typed narrowing, invariant checks, inode construction and unknown-error S.is(ErrnoException) checks. Add high-fanout descriptor/namespace and inspection-order regressions in internal/volume.coverage.test.ts and VolumePathsOrder.test.ts without machine-sensitive timing thresholds.
